messages:
mira: quick follow-up re: canary/autofallback design. i want to formalize 'softfail' semantics and how router+adjudicator coordinate.
kevin: ditto. last run we saw noisy flips when multiple routes triggered. need smoothing.
alex: proposal: adjudicator emits actions with (target_pct, ttl, confidence, reason). router applies via an apply-actions API and runs a local smoothing policy (EMA) to avoid abrupt jumps.
mira: yes. softfail = reduce variant share by X% for a cooldown window, not a hard kill. during softfail we still schedule reprobing.
tara: reprobing modes? passive vs active? and who pays for active probes (cost/latency)?
mira: two modes: passive (wait for existing traffic) and active (synthetic/replay/mirror). active probes only if current_pct < probe_min_pct. config controls allowed methods per deployment.
kevin: add confidence floor: if confidence < 0.6, route should mark action as advisory; router doesn't change allocation automatically, just flags it in telemetry.
ops-bot: add alert rule: if a variant enters softfail > 3 times in 1h -> page oncall.
alex: technical: adjudicator needs short-term state per-rollout: last_decision_ts, actions_queue, pending_rejoin. store in local Redis hash; decisions are idempotent by rollout_id+seq.
mira: ui: console shows "why-traffic-changed" with the latest decision, reason, confidence, and an appeal button. appeals create an audit event and can fast-track an active probe.
tara: security: in private deployments active mirror should be disallowed by default. synthetic or sanitized replay only.
kevin: router behavior: accept action, optionally reserve a probe_slot (hold_probe_slot) so adjudicator can run rejoin probes even if allocation is tiny. also apply global caps to avoid mass evictions.
mira: runbook: on softfail -> mark traces sampling for that route + enable short debug window. if probes fail -> escalate; if probes succeed -> gradually ramp back over rejoin_window.
alex: final: i'll draft the action proto and a minimal apply-actions API. follow-up quick sync tomorrow 10:00 to review PoC metrics we'll collect (decision.count, probe.results, applied.actions).
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary ab_v120 started by @mira at 1768881250, variant b @ 4% traffic.
mira: thanks all, i'll update RFC with softfail definition, action schema, and probe policies. see you tomorrow.
